shared_elements: torso with linear or geometric markings
justification: The main correspondence is that both present a vertically oriented anthropomorphic figure with a head/face above a torso bearing linear or geometric body markings. The biggest difference is that A is a naturalistic standing figure with modeled limbs, headdress, and held ritual objects, while B is a highly schematic frontal monolithic figure dominated by abstract circular and band motifs and no comparable held-object scene.
